description: This file contains Redux action creators and related functions for managing the right-hand side (RHS) UI component in the Mattermost web application, including search, post selection, plugin display, and RHS state management.

methods.name: selectPostWithPreviousState
methods.description: Dispatches an action to select a post, optionally considering previous RHS state.

methods.name: selectPostCardFromRightHandSideSearchWithPreviousState
methods.description: Dispatches an action to select a post card from RHS search with previous state context.

methods.name: updateRhsState
methods.description: Updates the RHS state, optionally with channel ID and previous RHS state.

methods.name: openShowEditHistory
methods.description: Opens the RHS in edit history view for a specific post.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Navigates RHS to previous state or default tab.

methods.name: selectPostFromRightHandSideSearch
methods.description: Selects a post from RHS search.

methods.name: selectPostFromRightHandSideSearchByPostId
methods.description: Selects a post by ID from RHS search.

methods.name: replyToLatestPostInChannel
methods.description: Selects the latest interactable post in a channel for reply.

methods.name: updateSearchTerms
methods.description: Updates the search terms in RHS.

methods.name: updateSearchTeam
methods.description: Updates the team context for RHS search.

methods.name: setRhsSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the RHS sidebar based on window width or provided size.

methods.name: updateSearchTermsForShortcut
methods.description: Updates search terms based on current channel for shortcut.

methods.name: updateSearchType
methods.description: Updates the search type in RHS.

methods.name: performSearch
methods.description: Performs search for posts and files with given terms and team ID.

methods.name: filterFilesSearchByExt
methods.description: Filters file search results by extensions.

methods.name: showSearchResults
methods.description: Displays search results in RHS, performing search with current terms.

methods.name: showRHSPlugin
methods.description: Displays a plugin in RHS by pluggable ID.

methods.name: showChannelMembers
methods.description: Shows channel members in RHS, optionally in editing mode.

methods.name: hideRHSPlugin
methods.description: Hides a plugin in RHS by pluggable ID.

methods.name: toggleRHSPlugin
methods.description: Toggles display of a plugin in RHS.

methods.name: showFlaggedPosts
methods.description: Displays flagged posts in RHS.

methods.name: showPinnedPosts
methods.description: Displays pinned posts in RHS.

methods.name: showChannelFiles
methods.description: Displays files in a channel in RHS.

methods.name: showMentions
methods.description: Displays mention results in RHS.

methods.name: showChannelInfo
methods.description: Displays channel info in RHS.

methods.name: closeRightHandSide
methods.description: Closes RHS and clears post selection.

methods.name: toggleMenu
methods.description: Toggles RHS menu visibility.

methods.name: openMenu
methods.description: Opens RHS menu.

methods.name: closeMenu
methods.description: Closes RHS menu.

methods.name: setRhsExpanded
methods.description: Sets RHS expanded state.

methods.name: toggleRhsExpanded
methods.description: Toggles RHS expanded state.

methods.name: selectPost
methods.description: Selects a post and updates RHS state.

methods.name: selectPostById
methods.description: Selects a post by ID, fetching if necessary.

methods.name: highlightReply
methods.description: Highlights a reply post.

methods.name: clearHighlightReply
methods.description: Clears reply highlight.

methods.name: debouncedClearHighlightReply
methods.description: Debounced function to clear reply highlight.

methods.name: selectPostAndHighlight
methods.description: Selects a post and highlights it, then clears highlight after delay.

methods.name: selectPostCard
methods.description: Selects a post card.

methods.name: openRHSSearch
methods.description: Opens RHS in search mode.

methods.name: openAtPrevious
methods.description: Restores RHS to previous state based on saved context.

methods.name: suppressRHS
methods.description: Action to suppress RHS.

methods.name: unsuppressRHS
methods.description: Action to unsuppress RHS.

methods.name: focusedRHS
methods.description: Marks RHS as focused.

methods.name: setEditChannelMembers
methods.description: Sets editing mode for channel members.

methods.name: measureRhsOpened
methods.description: Measures RHS open time for telemetry.
